title.rendered: Receive World-Class Medical Treatment in India—With Personal Concierge Support Every Step of the Way

content.rendered:
Why Ekamra ?

ADVANCED MEDICAL CARE * HOLISTIC HEALING * RICH CULTURE

Experience Elite Tier-1 tertiary care at comforting Tier-2 costs. Nestled within the tranquil nature and rich heritage of Odisha, Ekamra Medical Concierge acts as your personal guardian—seamlessly blending advanced medical treatments with a stress-free, deeply supportive recovery journey.

Book a Free Consultation
About Ekamra – Learn More

Find clear answers to your questions about planning your healing journey under the Ekamra canopy.

What exactly does Ekamra Medical Concierge do?

We are a premier medical value travel facilitator dedicated to bridging the gap between world-class tertiary healthcare and affordable, stress-free delivery. Think of us as your dedicated, 24/7 medical guardians and personal advocates. While our network of elite doctors focuses on your treatment, we take total care of all your non-medical complexities—including medical visa invitations, airport greeting logistics, local stays, and family comfort tours—ensuring a completely friction-free experience for you and your loved ones

Where are you based, and why are your offices located there?

Our registered corporate headquarters is located at The Landmarks, Sanjay Heights, Gadgadia Square, Proof Road, Balasore, Odisha. We intentionally anchored our administrative operations on these exact premises because it runs alongside our trusted, NABL-accredited Apollo Clinic footprint at Sanjay Heights. This established local clinic allows us to maintain immediate, real-time diagnostic capabilities and smoothly manage your 30-day post-discharge care cycle close to home. For surgical and major clinical procedures, our primary multi-specialty hospital partner network is located in the state capital of Bhubaneswar

What Medical Specialties and hospital standards do you offer?

Your clinical safety is our highest priority. To guarantee uncompromised care, we partner exclusively with JCI or NABH Accredited Multi-specialty Hospitals in Bhubaneswar, bypassing crowded metro lines to offer “Tier-1 Care at Tier-2 Costs”. Our core clinical network includes world-class institutions like Apollo Hospitals, SUM Ultimate Medicare, AMRI Hospitals, Care Hospitals, KIMS, and AIIMS Bhubaneswar. We selectively map your care to the region’s finest specialists in:

1. Advanced Cardiology, Oncology, and Transplants
2. Orthopaedics, Spine Surgery, Neurology, and Women’s Health
3. Modern Critical Care and minimally invasive Robotic Surgeries
4. Highly advanced Dental Care and Ophthalmology

How do you handle travel, local transport, and accommodation?

From the moment you land at Biju Patnaik International Airport (BBI), we treat you as our honored guest. We partner with experienced, premium travel operators who deploy sanitized, private, air-conditioned fleets with drivers specifically trained to assist foreign tourists and patients.
We coordinate all your Visa arrangements, Flight Alignments, arrange comfortable guest house or hotel stays near your designated hospital, and seamlessly transition you post-discharge to breathtaking, peaceful recovery sanctuaries like the Swosti Chilika Resort to let the natural beauty of Odisha rejuvenate your spirit.

Can you manage my remote follow-ups and home healthcare once I leave the hospital?

Absolutely. True healing does not end when you leave the operating theater. Before you depart, we coordinate directly with your surgical team to secure your final “Fit-to-Fly” clearance and hand over a neatly organized file of your digital records. Once you return home, our team initiates a structured 30-day medical follow-up cycle. Through our local diagnostic footprints and telemedicine platforms, we smoothly coordinate your remote specialist consultations, local lab sample tracking, and home healthcare touches so elderly or recovering patients never have to travel layout distances unnecessarily.

How do financial coordination and payments work?

We believe in absolute professional transparency, which is why we offer simple, fully digital, and secure payment pathways with zero hidden fees. Once your personalized care itinerary and all-inclusive cost estimate are finalized and approved by you, payments are processed in two clear stages:
1. Initial Booking Deposit: A structured, pre-agreed retainer fee is paid before you travel to secure your private video consultations with specialists, medical visa invitations, accommodation bookings, and airport logistics.
2. Flexible Treatment Balance: The remaining balance can be settled smoothly either prior to arrival or at the time of your formal hospital admission.
Our Secure Payment Channels: To make things effortless for both our domestic and international clients (including guests from the UAE, Bangladesh, or Singapore), we accept direct Wire Transfers (SWIFT/NEFT/RTGS), secure Online Credit/Debit Card Payments, and verified international digital payment gateways.

Financial Peace of Mind: All payments are fully invoiced through our registered corporate entity,
Ekamra Medical Concierge. Because we operate under strict pre-negotiated Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with our hospital network, your pricing is completely locked in—protecting your family from unexpected billing inflation or sudden surcharges at the discharge desk.

title.rendered: How We Operate: Our Integrated Care Model

content.rendered:
A Harmonized Network of Excellence. Your Personal Sanctuary of Care.

At Ekamra Medical Concierge, we do not believe in fragmented healthcare. We operate as a unified, end-to-end ecosystem where elite medical science, premium hospitality, and compassionate home healthcare work in perfect harmony. By managing all non-clinical complexities, we ensure zero friction for both the patient and the hospital

Our Clinical Network: Accredited Multi-Specialty Hospitals

Strict Quality Benchmarks: We exclusively partner with JCI or NABH Accredited Multi-specialty Hospitals to guarantee the highest international clinical standards, safety protocols, and surgical success rates.

We maintain direct coordination channels with hospital management to fast-track your admissions, clear insurance or paperwork friction, and completely eliminate exhausting wait lines for your family

.

Clinical Synergy: Elite Doctors & Pre-Travel Consultations

When you securely share your medical files, our team physically takes your records to 2-3 independent partner specialists across our network to secure a trusted second opinion and transparent clinical options.

To build absolute confidence, we facilitate a private, 30-45 minutes video consultation with the operating Specialist Doctor. This allows you to discuss your treatment plan, review doctor profiles, and establish an empathetic clinical connection from the comfort of your home


.

Travel & Logistics: Elite Transport & Premium Operators

We partner exclusively with experienced inbound travel aggregators who maintain fleets of highly sanitized, private, air-conditioned vehicles.

Your dedicated Ekamra Care Manager monitors your flight, coordinates your arrival timeline, and provides digital “Welcome Packs” with real-time driver details so you are never left waiting at a terminal gate

Post-Discharge & Transitional Care: Luxury Recovery Resorts

True recovery takes place beyond hospital walls. Upon final clinical discharge and “Fit-to-Fly” clearance, we smoothly transition you to premium wellness resorts.

In partnership with resort wellness spaces, we coordinate gentle, wheelchair-accessible local sightseeing tours and light physical rehabilitation tailored beautifully to your recovery pace. We ensure that your dietary requirements are fully met as per doctors advise.

Home Healthcare & Elderly Care Continuity

For our regional domestic catchment areas, our registered corporate office runs alongside the NABL-accredited Apollo Clinic, Balasore. This provides an immediate physical infrastructure for patient intake and continuous care.Once you return home, you enter our structured 30-day medical file and follow-up management cycle

For senior or convalescing patients, we leverage our local clinical setups to arrange home healthcare touchpoints, including remote follow-up consultations, local laboratory sample collections, and home diagnostic monitoring so vulnerable or elderly patients never have to travel unnecessarily

Financial Reliability & Transparent SLAs

We operate under strict, pre-negotiated Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with our hospital and hospitality partners
This completely protects you from hidden charges, sudden billing inflation, or surprise costs.

Backed by structured corporate working capital, Ekamra manages all financial coordination with service vendors seamlessly behind the scenes
This ensures that your local accommodation, transportation, and clinical billing move forward fluidly without interruption.

content.rendered:
HEALING BEYOND BOUNDARIES

“From Specialist Consultations and Treatment planning to Hospital coordination, Travel arrangements, and Post-treatment recovery – Ekamra helps access India’s best healthcare with complete peace of mind.”

At the heart of our name – EKAMRA lies a centuries-old tradition of Peace, Protection, and Deep Rejuvenation. The sacred land of the ancient mango tree forest—Bhubaneswar has long been revered as a historic sanctuary of cultural heritage and holistic well-being. Just as a grand, ancient tree provides a protective canopy of shade and shelter, Ekamra Medical Concierge serves as a comforting guardian for our patients.

We bridge the gap between world-class, JCI and NABH accredited tertiary healthcare – Apollo Hospitals, Care Hospitals, AIIMS – being few of them, and the serene, recuperative power of Odisha’s natural beauty. By choosing the name Ekamra, we pledge to envelop you and your family in a seamless world of Clinical Excellence, Absolute Operational Transparency, and Deeply Empathetic, Stress-free Hospitality.

By seamlessly combining this robust, world-class medical grid with affordable operational models, Odisha proudly delivers “Tier-1 Care at Tier-2 Costs.” It stands out as an unparalleled destination where patients can bypass the heavy crowds and soaring expenses of traditional metro hubs, stepping instead into a seamless world of advanced medical science and rejuvenating natural beauty.

content.rendered:
Once you are with Ekamra, our care managers ensure that all your worries are gone

Pre-Travel: Complete Clarity

We take the stress out of planning. Within 2 hours of your inquiry, our team securely gathers your medical history, coordinates with 2-3 elite specialists to secure a trusted second opinion, and provides a transparent, all-inclusive cost estimate.
We even set up a private video consultation with your doctor before you pack your bags.

Arrival: The Warmest Welcome

The moment you land at Biju Patnaik International Airport (BBI), you are family.
An Ekamra representative greets you at the gate with a custom welcome kit, a pre-activated local SIM card, and a private, air-conditioned vehicle to take you smoothly to your accommodation.

Treatment: Your Personal Advocate

While you focus on recovery, we handle the friction. Your dedicated care manager navigates all hospital paperwork, handles admission coordination, and manages insurance details so you never have to stand in a queue.

To keep your loved ones relaxed, we even organize gentle, comforting local tours while you rest.

Recovery: The Odisha Sanctuary

Healing continues beautifully beyond the clinical walls.
After hospital discharge, we transition you to premium, peaceful wellness resorts—such as the serene Swosti Chilika—for gentle rest, light physiotherapy, customized dietary care, and accessible heritage sightseeing.

Post-Care: Continuous Support

Our relationship doesn’t end when you fly home. We manage a full 30-day medical follow-up cycle, handle your remote consultations, organize your digital health files, and check in on your recovery milestones to ensure your health remains perfectly on track

At Ekamra, we ensure not just a treatment, we promise an Experience

Where World Class Healthcare Heritage and the Serene Promise of Healing

Our Mission is simple yet deeply transformative: To connect domestic and international patients with affordable, world-class tertiary healthcare, while enveloping them in the recuperative serenity of Odisha’s breathtaking nature and rich cultural heritage.

The “Healing & Heritage” Experience

“Healing & Heritage” – Based in the culturally vibrant and naturally tranquil state of Odisha, we have pioneered a unique approach to medical value travel. We treat you not just as a patient, but as our honored guest.

We partner with the best hospital networks in Bhubaneswar. These include Apollo Hospitals, CARE Hospitals, KIMS and many more. We ensure that you get the best care from the best doctor.

Ekamra is led by Industry Veterans in Hospitality and Healthcare. Our Care Managers specialize in giving top-notch customer service and are fluent in multiple languages. Balasore serves as our official registered corporate headquarters, uniquely operating alongside our trusted, multi-specialty Apollo Clinic facility. Beyond its clinical value, Balasore offers a peaceful healing environment shaped by the unique receding waves of Chandipur Beach and the tranquil hills of Nilgiri.
